Metal bunk beds are arranged in two tiers along both sides of the hallway. The ceiling is arched with skylights providing illumination. A metal railing runs along the upper level or balcony edge. The scene appears somewhat dilapidated with graffiti on the walls.

The geometry of the ceiling arches and skylights warps slightly inconsistently with the linear perspective of the floor tiles. The skylight shapes become irregular and non-uniform as they recede.

The graffiti text/scribbles on the right wall appear smudged and lack distinct character definition, typical of AI-generated text artifacts. The texture of the yellow paint also shows slight blotchiness.
The horizontal railing of the upper bunk on the right side appears to fuse into the vertical support post without a clear joint or weld, creating a 'melting' effect.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the bunk beds. AI often struggles with the intricate lattice of metal bars in furniture. Check if the bars terminate logically or vanish into the mattress/floor. Also, verify if the 'graffiti' is just noise or if it attempts to form letters that fail (text artifact). The lighting from the skylights should cast consistent shadows; check for shadow mismatches under the bunks.
